email.question: Tell me about your favorite color. Write a short professional response explaining which color you like and why.
email.correctAnswer: My favorite color is blue. I like it because it feels calm and professional. I especially prefer navy blue because it represents trust, confidence, and stability. It is also a color that I find easy to work with in both design and everyday life. Thank you for giving me the opportunity to share my preference.

typing: My favorite color is blue. I like it because it feels calm and professional. I especially prefer navy blue because it represents trust, confidence, and stability. It is a color that I find easy to work with in both design and everyday life.
voiceD: You can either go to the cinema or stay at home.

Above all, we should always be honest.

storyG.question: Tell me about your Happiest Moment (Getting your first job offer).
storyG.correctAnswer: I woke up early and got ready for my interview. I reached the office on time. I greeted the interviewer with a smile. I answered all the interview questions confidently. I completed all the interview rounds successfully. I went back home and waited for the result. I received a phone call from the HR team. They offered me my first job. I thanked the HR for giving me this opportunity. I immediately shared the good news with my family. My parents congratulated me and felt proud. We celebrated the special day together. We ordered my favorite food. We clicked many happy pictures. My friends also congratulated me. I thanked God for this wonderful opportunity. I promised myself to work hard. I became more confident about my future. That day became a beautiful memory. It was the happiest moment of my life. Thank you for giving me this opportunity!
keywords: answered all the interview questions confidently
completed all the interview rounds successfully
phone call from the HR team
shared the good news with my family

trueFalse.q: 1. 'Either...or' is used to express a choice between two options.
2. 'Neither...nor' is used to show that both options are possible.
3. 'For example' is used to introduce an example.
4. 'Unlike' is used to show similarity between two subjects.
5. 'Above all' is used to emphasize the most important point.
